title: Runtime scale bound
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers with $n>0$, and let $I$ be the deterministic Goldreich–Levin input of dimension $n$, learning parameter $1/(4\cdot 2^k)$, and Fourier bound $2^{k+1}$. Then the runtime scale of $I$ is at most $12(n+1)(2^k+1)^2$.
